Blick Bits

Tricones & PDC Bits

Manufactured to exacting standards. Proven in Australasian conditions.

Blick Bits are manufactured in China and proven across New Zealand and Australian ground conditions. We stock a wide range of tricone and PDC sizes to cover everything from small-diameter geotech bores to large HDD crossings.

Tricones feature sealed roller bearings and shirt-tail hard facing as standard. PDC bits use deep wing designs with large inserts and hard facing for fast cutting and long life. Both are available in common sizes with local stock.

Why Blick Bits

Quality bits. Local stock. Competitive pricing.

Common Sizes in Stock

From 3⅞″ to 9⅞″ in both tricone and PDC — we carry the sizes most commonly used in HDD, geotech, and waterwell drilling across Australasia.

Proven Performance

Manufactured to exacting standards with sealed roller bearings (tricones) and reinforced deep wing designs (PDCs). Every bit is built for tough Australasian ground conditions.

Great Value

Fast cutting, long lasting bits at competitive prices. We also supply new Terelion bits and ex-oilfield rerun tricones for cost-effective alternatives on less demanding applications.

Product Range

Two bit types for every ground condition

Choose tricones for harder rock and mixed formations, or PDCs for fast progress in softer ground. Contact us for sizing advice and availability.

Tricone Bits

Roller cone bits in steel tooth and TCI (Tungsten Carbide Insert) configurations. Sealed roller bearings and shirt-tail hard facing are standard. 18 sizes from 2¼″ to 9⅞″ covering all common pin connections.

View tricone specs ↓

PDC Bits

Polycrystalline Diamond Compact bits with deep wing designs, hard facing, and large PDC inserts. Precisely aligned cutters ensure rapid and straight progress. 7 sizes from 3⅞″ to 9⅞″ in 3 to 6 wing configurations.

View PDC specs ↓

Need Help?

Not sure which bit suits your ground?

Tricones work best in harder rock and mixed formations where rolling action handles the load. PDCs excel in softer ground where shearing action means faster progress. Our team can help you choose the right bit for your ground conditions, hole size, and rig setup.

We stock the most common sizes across both bit types. Custom orders and specialist requirements available on request.

Run It With

Pair your bits with Blick Fluids

The right fluid system keeps your bit cutting efficiently — managing cuttings, cooling the bit face, and stabilising the hole behind it.

Stabiliser

Carry Flow

Suspension and carrying capacity for cuttings — keeps the bore clean and the bit cutting fresh ground.

 Core Fluid

HDD Gel

Premium bentonite for hole stability and fluid-loss control — supports the bit face in all ground types.

 Lubricant

Torque Down

Reduces friction and torque on the drill string — lowers stress on bit and rod connections.

 Thread Compound

Rod Grease

Protects threads during makeup and breakout — prevents galling at the bit-to-rod connection.
